primaryOutcomes.measure: Progression Free Survival (PFS) by central review of RECIST data
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Radiologic scans performed at baseline then every ~12 weeks for ~2 years, then every ~24 weeks thereafter until objective radiological disease progression. Study data collection expected to last for ~7 years.
